summary.text: Everett Jackson is the Republican nominee for the open Texas 30th District seat. FOX 4 describes him as a small business owner and community organizer. He advanced from the March 2026 Republican primary and won the May 26, 2026 runoff over Sholdon Daniels.

paragraphs.text: Described by FOX 4 News as a small business owner and community organizer.
Also known as "Pharaoh," according to Ballotpedia.
Advanced from the March 3, 2026 Republican primary, which also included Sholdon Daniels, Gregor Heise and Nils Walker, to a runoff, then defeated Daniels in the May 26, 2026 runoff.
